answer: Admission requires each agent to post a refundable bond and pass a verifiable delay proof before its first vote, a cost no script can fake in bulk. Identities sit in a layered register like shale: every signed action weaves one thread into the stratum, so a duplicate account surfaces instantly as two threads from one origin. Peer auditors sample the register daily; a proven sybil forfeits its bond to the audit pool and its stratum is marked dead reef, so 1000 fakes cost 1000 bonds plus delay proofs while an honest agent pays once.
